pages.text: $(li)$(l)Questbook missing?$() Run $(5)/bq_admin default load$() to restore it.$(li)$(l)Don't eat Candyland food or dried Vishroom$(); they crash the game.

$(li)$(l)Checkbox quests$() have to be ticked by each player separately, even in the same party; all other quest progress is shared.$(li)$(l)Enchanted books with enchantments that don't exist$() drop from some mobs; void them.
